Design concepts

This is the home of design concepts for the Open Home Foundation. Each folder is a self contained exploration of an idea.

These are design concepts, not products Nothing here is production software. Data is fictional, features are mockups and nothing you see is final or committed. Do not rely on anything on this site.

  • Device Database · Open Home Foundation

    device-database/

  • Connect Proxy · Devices – Home Assistant

    The Home Assistant device page for the Connect Proxy, with an inline setup banner that adapts its copy as you configure each capability.

    esphome-device-wizard/

  • Home Assistant - Covers refinement

    ha-covers-refinement/

  • Home Assistant for the whole household

    A navigable prototype of Home Assistant for the whole household: one shared home seen by many people, organised around who lives in it rather than how the tech works. It pressure-tests the two roles (Maintainer and Resident) and four spaces (Shared, Personal, Admin, Unresolved), and the navigation across six demo personas.

    ha-for-household/
